main_text.p: שָׁתַל Plantavit. Præt. וְשָׁתַלְתִּי Et plantabo, Ezech. 17. v.22. Partic. Pahul, נַעַץ שָׁתוּל Sicut arbor plantata, Psalm.1.3. Futur. אֶשְׁתָּלֵנּוּ [?] Plantabo illum, Ezech.7. v.23.
שְׁתִילִים m.p. Plantæ, Plantulæ: Constr. כְּשְׁתִילֵי זֵיתִים Sicut plantulæ olearum, Psal.128.3.

שָׁתַם Aperire, Recludere: Hinc tantùm Partic. Pah. Constr. שְׁתֻם הָעַיִן Aperti oculis, Numer.24.3. id est, Cui oculi nunc illustrati sunt ad res futuras prævidendas: V. seq. eodem sensu dicitur גָּלוּי Retectus. Chaldæus, Qui pulchrè videt. Aben Esra: Opponitur ipsi סְתוּם Occlusus, Obturatus. R. Salomon hic ridiculus. Qua affert ex Doctorum priscorum sententia, extant in Cod. Talmud. Nidda, cap.3. fol.31. Legat qui delectatur.
שִׁתַּן Hiph. הִשְׁתִּין Mingere: Part. præsens, מַשְׁתִּין Mingens, 1.Sam.25.22.34.
שָׁתַק Tacuit, Conticuit, Siluit: Futurum, יִשְׁתֹּק [?] וַיִּשְׁתֹּק הַיָּם מָדוֹן Silebit contentio, Prov.26.20. Et conticescat mare, Jon.1, verf.11. יִשְׁתְּקוּ Conticuerunt, Psalm.107.20.

תָּא m. Thalamus: [illegible, ~10 letters] Procæton, sive Excubitoriū stipatorum regis vel principis, 1.Reg.14.v.28. Plural. וּבֵין הַתָּאִים Et inter thalamos, Ezech.40.7. Construct. וְתָאֵי הַשָּׁעַר Et thalami portæ, v.10. Aff. וְתָאָו Et thalami ejus, v.21. Fœm. לִפְנֵי הַתָּאוֹת Ante thalamos, v.12.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms copied from the scan at reduced resolution; vowel points and some letters are uncertain, marked [?]. The Greek word after "Thalamus:" is not legible. The entry for תאב at the foot is the catchword. Headword ת is a letter heading set as a paragraph. The Hebrew in the entry שתק (Futurum line) is set in two lines with the Latin glosses and may be in a different order than printed; the readings marked [?] should be checked.
